campaign_strategy: Move current customers from informed consideration to attendance without repeating the same product pitch. Email 1 uses the LUCI Upgrade Overview as the decision aid before registration. Email 2 makes the preview concrete with three takeaways and gives registrants and nonregistrants clearly labeled next steps. Email 3 is registrant-only logistics. Email 4 restores the same product view for non-attendees, with the recording primary and the overview secondary. The tone moves from invitational to concrete to logistical to accommodating. More day-to-day programming control remains paired with continuing LUCI support throughout.
open_questions: Who should be the named sender and signer: the customer’s usual LUCI contact, one campaign-wide customer lead, or Marketing?
Should email 2 use two visible links in one shared send, or should ActiveCampaign swap only the final CTA line by registration status?
Will [AGENDA LINK] point to a standalone agenda, a calendar event, or the registration confirmation page?
Confirm the final values for [WEBINAR DATE], [WEBINAR TIME], [WEBINAR PLATFORM], [REGISTRATION LINK], [JOIN LINK], [CALENDAR LINK], and [RECORDING LINK].
Should the recording link remain available indefinitely, or should the follow-up avoid implying a lasting archive?
